Elephants are sanctuary animals. They are unlocked at reputation level 3.

Like all other sanctuary animals, players can only have four of them, one of each type.

Appearance

Elephants have two different appearances: brown and grey.

When players tap on the grey elephant, it finds a pink duster and starts to sweep the ground with it. When players tap on the brown elephant, it picks up some mud from the ground with its trunk and throws it onto its back for a mud bath.

When players tap on the grey elephant calf, it blows dust out of its trunk. When players tap on the brown elephant calf, a chicken appears and sits down in front of the calf. The calf plops down on its belly and watches the chicken and then playfully knocks it over with its trunk.

Brown

Grey

Unlocking elephants

Unlike other animals, elephants cannot be bought. Players must unlock them by finding puzzle pieces (which are collected in a log book). 36 pieces are required for each animal.

Once players have obtained the first elephant, the puzzle for the second elephant is unlocked. After both adult elephants have been added to the sanctuary, the puzzle for one of the calves is unlocked.

Players get the first sanctuary animal for free once the sanctuary is opened. The animal is chosen at random and can be an elephant, hippo or giraffe.

Placing elephants

Players must pick up an elephant house to be able to place the animal in the sanctuary. The house is free and can be obtained from the Shop. Shop.

When the second puzzle is completed, players are asked to upgrade the house, which does not cost anything. The same happens when players complete the calf puzzle. When the house is big enough to welcome a new animal, it is delivered in a crate, "airlifted" into the sanctuary by balloons.

Feeding elephants

Elephants are fed with wheat bundles. Once elephants have eaten they roam the sanctuary for ten hours and finally fall asleep. Players can immediately wake them up to receive 25 xp per animal. Elephants stay asleep otherwise.

Elephants which have been woken up but are not fed for a long while cannot fall asleep and wander around looking sleepy and tired.

Decorations

Each elephant unlocks some decorations as specified below:

Baobab Tree (Grey)
Blooming Cactus (Grey calf)
Elephant Ear Plant (Grey calf)
Dry Log (Brown)
Orange Ice Plant (Brown calf)
Sago Palm (Brown calf)
Tall Grass (Brown)
Termite Mound (Grey)

With each animal players are given the first pair of decorations for free. They are unlocked in the Shop when you get the first animal.
